# Collective announces $100 million for AI financial-platform plans


By OpenTools Team


The company links new financing to greater automation and a planned expansion to businesses with employees.


##


Capital for development


The[founder’s announcement](https://www.collective.com/blog/100m-to-power-the-new-era-of-solo-business) announces $100 million in new financing to build Collective’s financial platform. It plans more AI work across accounting, taxes, payroll and support, alongside additional services.


##


Employer access is planned


Serving businesses with employees is described as an expansion goal. The announcement does not establish a new eligibility date or completed launch for that group.


Collective co‑founder Hooman Radfar at Tech Cocktail Sessions DC in June 2013. Archival photograph, not the financing announcement.
